practiceQuestions.q: In a direct speech sentence, what is the term used for the clause that contains the speaker and the reporting verb?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: प्रत्यक्ष कथन (Direct Speech) के वाक्य में, उस खंड (Clause) को क्या कहा जाता है जिसमें वक्ता और रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब होते हैं?
opts: Reported Speech Clause
Reporting Verb Clause
Inverted Clause
Conjunction Clause
opts_hi: रिपोर्टेड स्पीच क्लॉज
रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब क्लॉज
इन्वर्टेड क्लॉज
कंजंक्शन क्लॉज
practiceQuestions.sol: The clause containing the speaker and the reporting verb (e.g., 'He said to me') is called the Reporting Verb Clause.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: जिस खंड में वक्ता और रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब (जैसे - He said to me) होते हैं, उसे रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब क्लॉज कहा जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the primary function of the 'Reported Speech' enclosed within quotation marks?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: उद्धरण चिन्हों के भीतर बंद 'रिपोर्टेड स्पीच' का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
opts: To introduce the speaker
To contain the actual words spoken by the speaker
To indicate the time of speech
To connect two independent clauses
opts_hi: वक्ता का परिचय देना
वक्ता द्वारा बोले गए वास्तविक शब्दों को समाहित करना
भाषण के समय को इंगित करना
दो स्वतंत्र खंडों को जोड़ना
practiceQuestions.sol: The Reported Speech enclosed within quotation marks contains the actual words spoken by the speaker.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: उद्धरण चिन्हों के भीतर बंद रिपोर्टेड स्पीच में वक्ता द्वारा बोले गए वास्तविक शब्द होते हैं।

practiceQuestions.q: According to the SON rule for pronoun conversion in direct/indirect speech, what does 'S' stand for?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: प्रत्यक्ष/अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण में सर्वनाम परिवर्तन के लिए SON नियम के अनुसार, 'S' का क्या अर्थ है?
opts: Speech
Subject
Structure
Statement
opts_hi: स्पीच
सब्जेक्ट (कर्ता)
स्ट्रक्चर
स्टेटमेंट
practiceQuestions.sol: In the SON rule (1st Person -> Subject, 2nd Person -> Object, 3rd Person -> No change), 'S' stands for Subject.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: SON नियम (पहला पुरुष -> सब्जेक्ट, दूसरा पुरुष -> ऑब्जेक्ट, तीसरा पुरुष -> कोई बदलाव नहीं) में, 'S' का अर्थ Subject (कर्ता) है।

practiceQuestions.q: In the SON rule, what does 'O' stand for?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: SON नियम में, 'O' का क्या अर्थ है?
opts: Object
Option
Original
Output
opts_hi: ऑब्जेक्ट (कर्म)
ऑप्शन
ओरिजिनल
आउटपुट
practiceQuestions.sol: In the SON rule, 'O' stands for Object, which governs the change of Second Person pronouns.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: SON नियम में, 'O' का अर्थ Object (कर्म) है, जो सेकंड पर्सन (द्वितीय पुरुष) सर्वनाम के परिवर्तन को नियंत्रित करता है।

practiceQuestions.q: According to the SON rule, how do Third Person pronouns change in indirect speech?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: SON नियम के अनुसार, अप्रत्यक्ष कथन में थर्ड पर्सन (तृतीय पुरुष) के सर्वनाम कैसे बदलते हैं?
opts: They change according to the Subject
They change according to the Object
They remain unchanged (No Change)
They change to First Person
opts_hi: वे कर्ता के अनुसार बदलते हैं
वे कर्म के अनुसार बदलते हैं
वे अपरिवर्तित रहते हैं (कोई बदलाव नहीं)
वे प्रथम पुरुष में बदल जाते हैं
practiceQuestions.sol: Third Person pronouns (he, she, it, they, etc.) remain unchanged in indirect speech according to the SON rule.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: SON नियम के अनुसार अप्रत्यक्ष कथन में थर्ड पर्सन के सर्वनाम (he, she, it, they आदि) अपरिवर्तित रहते हैं।

practiceQuestions.q: When converting direct to indirect speech, what does the word 'now' change into?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: प्रत्यक्ष को अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण में बदलते समय, 'now' शब्द किसमें बदल जाता है?
opts: then
there
that
thus
opts_hi: then
there
that
thus
practiceQuestions.sol: Words denoting nearness in time like 'now' change to 'then' in indirect narration.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: समय की समीपता दर्शाने वाले शब्द जैसे 'now' अप्रत्यक्ष कथन में 'then' में बदल जाते हैं।

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following time/place adverbs correctly changes to 'there' in indirect speech?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा समय/स्थान क्रियाविशेषण अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण में सही रूप से 'there' में बदल जाता है?
opts: Now
Here
This
Today
opts_hi: Now
Here
This
Today
practiceQuestions.sol: 'Here' changes to 'there' when converting from direct to indirect speech.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: प्रत्यक्ष से अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण में बदलते समय 'Here', 'there' में बदल जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: In indirect narration, 'tomorrow' is generally converted into which of the following?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन में, 'tomorrow' को सामान्यतः निम्नलिखित में से किसमें परिवर्तित किया जाता है?
opts: the previous day
the next day
that day
the day before yesterday
opts_hi: the previous day
the next day
that day
the day before yesterday
practiceQuestions.sol: 'Tomorrow' changes to 'the next day' or 'the following day' in indirect speech.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण में 'Tomorrow' बदलकर 'the next day' या 'the following day' हो जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the general rule for tense shift when the reporting verb is in the Present or Future tense?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: जब रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब Present या Future Tense में हो, तो Tense परिवर्तन का सामान्य नियम क्या है?
opts: Tense of the reported speech changes to past
Tense of the reported speech does not change
Tense changes to future
Tense becomes passive
opts_hi: रिपोर्टेड स्पीच का काल भूतकाल में बदल जाता है
रिपोर्टेड स्पीच का काल नहीं बदलता है
काल भविष्य काल में बदल जाता है
काल पैसिव हो जाता है
practiceQuestions.sol: If the reporting verb is in the Present or Future tense, the tense of the reported speech does not change.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: यदि रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब Present या Future tense में है, तो रिपोर्टेड स्पीच का tense नहीं बदलता है।

practiceQuestions.q: In direct to indirect speech conversion, Simple Present tense (V1/Do/Does) changes to:
practiceQuestions.q_hi: डायरेक्ट से इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में बदलते समय, सिंपल प्रेजेंट टेंस (V1/Do/Does) किसमें बदलता है?
opts: Simple Present
Simple Past (V2/Did)
Past Continuous
Past Perfect
opts_hi: सिंपल प्रेजेंट
सिंपल पास्ट (V2/Did)
पास्ट कंटीन्यूअस
पास्ट परफेक्ट
practiceQuestions.sol: Simple Present tense (V1/Do/Does) changes to Simple Past (V2/Did) when the reporting verb is in the past tense.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: जब रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब पास्ट टेंस में हो, तो सिंपल प्रेजेंट टेंस (V1/Do/Does) सिंपल पास्ट (V2/Did) में बदल जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Present Continuous tense (Is/am/are + V1-ing) in direct speech changes to which tense in indirect speech?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: प्रत्यक्ष भाषण में Present Continuous tense (Is/am/are + V1-ing) अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण में किस काल में बदलता है?
opts: Past Continuous (was/were + V1-ing)
Present Perfect
Past Perfect Continuous
Simple Past
opts_hi: पास्ट कंटीन्यूअस (was/were + V1-ing)
प्रेजेंट परफेक्ट
पास्ट परफेक्ट कंटीन्यूअस
सिंपल पास्ट
practiceQuestions.sol: Present Continuous changes to Past Continuous (was/were + V1-ing) under past reporting verbs.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: पास्ट रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब के तहत Present Continuous बदलकर Past Continuous (was/were + V1-ing) हो जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Which modal verb changes to 'could' in indirect narration?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन में कौन सा मॉडल वर्ब 'could' में बदल जाता है?
opts: Will
Shall
Can
May
opts_hi: Will
Shall
Can
May
practiceQuestions.sol: 'Can' changes to 'could' when converting direct speech into indirect speech.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: डायरेक्ट स्पीच को इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में बदलते समय 'Can' बदलकर 'could' हो जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the correct transformation of 'said to' in an assertive sentence of direct speech?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: प्रत्यक्ष भाषण के एक साधारण वाक्य (assertive sentence) में 'said to' का सही परिवर्तन क्या है?
opts: asked
ordered
told
requested
opts_hi: asked
ordered
told
requested
practiceQuestions.sol: In an assertive sentence, 'said to' is converted to 'told' if there is an object, or kept as 'said' if there is no object.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: एक साधारण वाक्य में, यदि कर्म (object) है तो 'said to' को 'told' में बदल दिया जाता है, या कर्म न होने पर 'said' ही रहने दिया जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Which conjunction is normally used to join the reporting verb and reported speech in an assertive sentence?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: एक साधारण वाक्य में रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब और रिपोर्टेड स्पीच को जोड़ने के लिए सामान्यतः किस कंजंक्शन का उपयोग किया जाता है?
opts: if
whether
that
to
opts_hi: if
whether
that
to
practiceQuestions.sol: The conjunction 'that' is used to introduce the reported speech in assertive sentences.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: साधारण वाक्यों में रिपोर्टेड स्पीच को जोड़ने के लिए 'that' कंजंक्शन का उपयोग किया जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: When converting a universal truth from direct to indirect speech, what happens to its tense?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: किसी सार्वभौमिक सत्य (universal truth) को प्रत्यक्ष से अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण में बदलते समय उसके काल (tense) का क्या होता है?
opts: It changes to past tense
It changes to future tense
It remains unchanged
It becomes passive voice
opts_hi: यह भूतकाल में बदल जाता है
यह भविष्य काल में बदल जाता है
यह अपरिवर्तित रहता है
यह पैसिव वॉइस बन जाता है
practiceQuestions.sol: Universal truths, scientific facts, and habitual actions never undergo tense shift in indirect speech.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: सार्वभौमिक सत्य, वैज्ञानिक तथ्य और आदतन कार्य अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण में कभी भी काल परिवर्तन से नहीं गुजरते।

practiceQuestions.q:
Convert the following direct sentence into indirect speech:
He said, "I am writing a letter."
practiceQuestions.q_hi:
निम्नलिखित प्रत्यक्ष वाक्य को अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण में बदलें:
He said, "I am writing a letter."
opts: He said that he is writing a letter.
He said that he was writing a letter.
He told that he was writing a letter.
He said that I was writing a letter.
opts_hi: He said that he is writing a letter.
He said that he was writing a letter.
He told that he was writing a letter.
He said that I was writing a letter.
practiceQuestions.sol: 'I' (1st person) changes to 'He', 'am writing' (Present Cont.) changes to 'was writing' (Past Cont.), and 'that' is used as a conjunction.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'I' (प्रथम पुरुष) बदलकर 'He' हो जाता है, 'am writing' (Present Cont.) बदलकर 'was writing' (Past Cont.) हो जाता है, और 'that' कंजंक्शन के रूप में प्रयुक्त होता है।

practiceQuestions.q:
Identify the correct indirect form of:
She said to me, "Where are you going?"
practiceQuestions.q_hi:
निम्नलिखित का सही अप्रत्यक्ष रूप पहचानें:
She said to me, "Where are you going?"
opts: She asked me where was I going.
She asked me where you were going.
She asked me where I was going.
She told me where am I going.
opts_hi: She asked me where was I going.
She asked me where you were going.
She asked me where I was going.
She told me where am I going.
practiceQuestions.sol: In Wh- questions, 'said to' becomes 'asked', the Wh- word acts as the conjunction, and the sentence becomes assertive (subject before verb: 'I was going').
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: Wh- प्रश्नों में 'said to' बदलकर 'asked' हो जाता है, Wh- शब्द कंजंक्शन का काम करता है, और वाक्य साधारण बन जाता है (कर्ता पहले, क्रिया बाद में: 'I was going').

practiceQuestions.q:
Choose the correct indirect narration for:
They said, "We have completed our homework."
practiceQuestions.q_hi:
इसके लिए सही अप्रत्यक्ष कथन चुनें:
They said, "We have completed our homework."
opts: They said that they have completed their homework.
They said that they had completed their homework.
They told that they had completed our homework.
They said that we had completed their homework.
opts_hi: They said that they have completed their homework.
They said that they had completed their homework.
They told that they had completed our homework.
They said that we had completed their homework.
practiceQuestions.sol: 'We' changes to 'they', 'have completed' (Present Perfect) changes to 'had completed' (Past Perfect), and 'our' changes to 'their'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'We' बदलकर 'they' हो जाता है, 'have completed' (Present Perfect) बदलकर 'had completed' (Past Perfect) हो जाता है, और 'our' बदलकर 'their' हो जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q:
Transform into indirect speech:
The teacher said, "The earth revolves around the sun."
practiceQuestions.q_hi:
अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण में बदलें:
The teacher said, "The earth revolves around the sun."
opts: The teacher said that the earth revolved around the sun.
The teacher said that the earth revolves around the sun.
The teacher told that the earth has revolved around the sun.
The teacher asked if the earth revolves around the sun.
opts_hi: The teacher said that the earth revolved around the sun.
The teacher said that the earth revolves around the sun.
The teacher told that the earth has revolved around the sun.
The teacher asked if the earth revolves around the sun.
practiceQuestions.sol: Since 'The earth revolves around the sun' is a universal truth, the tense ('revolves') remains unchanged.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: चूंकि 'The earth revolves around the sun' एक सार्वभौमिक सत्य है, इसलिए काल ('revolves') अपरिवर्तित रहता है।

practiceQuestions.q:
Select the correct indirect speech for:
He said to her, "Please help me."
practiceQuestions.q_hi:
इसके लिए सही अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण चुनें:
He said to her, "Please help me."
opts: He requested her to help him.
He told her to please help him.
He ordered her that help him.
He requested her that she should help me.
opts_hi: He requested her to help him.
He told her to please help him.
He ordered her that help him.
He requested her that she should help me.
practiceQuestions.sol: In imperative sentences with 'please', 'said to' changes to 'requested', 'please' is dropped, and the infinitive 'to help' is used with pronoun change ('me' to 'him').
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'please' वाले आज्ञासूचक वाक्यों में 'said to' बदलकर 'requested' हो जाता है, 'please' को हटा दिया जाता है, और सर्वनाम परिवर्तन ('me' से 'him') के साथ इन्फिनिटिव 'to help' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q:
What is the correct indirect conversion of:
Rahul said, "Alas! I have lost my wallet."
practiceQuestions.q_hi: Rahul said, "Alas! I have lost my wallet." का सही अप्रत्यक्ष रूपांतरण क्या है?
opts: Rahul exclaimed with sorrow that he had lost his wallet.
Rahul said with joy that he has lost his wallet.
Rahul exclaimed that alas he had lost his wallet.
Rahul told with sorrow that I lost my wallet.
opts_hi: Rahul exclaimed with sorrow that he had lost his wallet.
Rahul said with joy that he has lost his wallet.
Rahul exclaimed that alas he had lost his wallet.
Rahul told with sorrow that I lost my wallet.
practiceQuestions.sol: Exclamatory sentences expressing sorrow use 'exclaimed with sorrow' (or grief), drop interjections like 'Alas!', use 'that', and shift tenses ('have lost' to 'had lost').
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: दुख व्यक्त करने वाले विस्मयादिबोधक वाक्यों में 'exclaimed with sorrow' का प्रयोग होता है, 'Alas!' जैसे विस्मयादिबोधक हट जाते हैं, 'that' लगता है और काल बदलता है ('have lost' से 'had lost').

practiceQuestions.q:
Find the correct indirect form of:
She said, "Will you open the door, John?"
practiceQuestions.q_hi:
निम्नलिखित का सही अप्रत्यक्ष रूप ज्ञात करें:
She said, "Will you open the door, John?"
opts: She asked John if he will open the door.
She asked John to open the door.
She asked John if he would open the door.
She told John that will you open the door.
opts_hi: She asked John if he will open the door.
She asked John to open the door.
She asked John if he would open the door.
She told John that will you open the door.
practiceQuestions.sol: When a person is addressed by name in the reporting speech (John), it becomes the object of the reporting verb ('She asked John'). Yes/No questions use 'if' or 'whether' and modal shift ('will' to 'would').
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: जब रिपोर्टेड स्पीच में किसी व्यक्ति को नाम से संबोधित किया जाता है (John), तो वह रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब का कर्म बन जाता है ('She asked John'). Yes/No प्रश्न 'if' या 'whether' और मॉडल परिवर्तन ('will' से 'would') का उपयोग करते हैं।

practiceQuestions.q:
Choose the correct indirect narration:
Father said to me, "Work hard if you want to succeed."
practiceQuestions.q_hi:
सही अप्रत्यक्ष कथन चुनें:
Father said to me, "Work hard if you want to succeed."
opts: Father advised me to work hard if you want to succeed.
Father advised me to work hard if I wanted to succeed.
Father ordered me that work hard if I want to succeed.
Father requested me to work hard if I want to succeed.
opts_hi: Father advised me to work hard if you want to succeed.
Father advised me to work hard if I wanted to succeed.
Father ordered me that work hard if I want to succeed.
Father requested me to work hard if I want to succeed.
practiceQuestions.sol: Imperative advice uses 'advised', followed by 'to work hard', and the conditional clause undergoes pronoun ('you' to 'I') and tense ('want' to 'wanted') changes.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: आज्ञासूचक सलाह में 'advised' का प्रयोग होता है, उसके बाद 'to work hard' आता है, और शर्त वाले खंड में सर्वनाम ('you' से 'I') और काल ('want' से 'wanted') परिवर्तन होता है।

practiceQuestions.q:
Identify the error in this incorrect indirect speech sentence and select its correct version:
Direct: He said, "Are you coming with me?"
Incorrect Indirect: He asked me that if I was coming with him.
practiceQuestions.q_hi:
इस गलत अप्रत्यक्ष वाक्य में त्रुटि को पहचानें और इसका सही संस्करण चुनें:
Direct: He said, "Are you coming with me?"
Incorrect Indirect: He asked me that if I was coming with him.
opts: He asked me if I was coming with him.
He asked me that whether I was coming with him.
He asked me if was I coming with him.
He asked me whether that I was coming with him.
opts_hi: He asked me if I was coming with him.
He asked me that whether I was coming with him.
He asked me if was I coming with him.

practiceQuestions.q: Identify the incorrect transformation among the following direct-indirect pairs:
practiceQuestions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित प्रत्यक्ष-अप्रत्यक्ष युग्मों में से गलत रूपांतरण की पहचान करें:
opts: Direct: She said, 'I am reading a book.' -> Indirect: She said that she was reading a book.

practiceQuestions.q: Convert into indirect speech: She said to me, "Where are you going?"

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following sentences correctly applies the SON rule for pronouns?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वाक्य सर्वनाम के लिए SON नियम को सही ढंग से लागू करता है?
opts: He said to me, 'You have done your work.' -> He told me that I have done my work.
She said to him, 'My book is better than your book.' -> She told him that her book was better than his book.
I said to her, 'You are wise.' -> I told her that you were wise.
They said to us, 'We will help you.' -> They told us that they will help us.
opts_hi: He said to me, 'You have done your work.' -> He told me that I have done my work.
She said to him, 'My book is better than your book.' -> She told him that her book was better than his book.
I said to her, 'You are wise.' -> I told her that you were wise.
They said to us, 'We will help you.' -> They told us that they will help us.
practiceQuestions.sol: 'My' (1st person) changes to 'her' (subject of reporting verb - She). 'Your' (2nd person) changes to 'his' (object of reporting verb - him). This is correctly applied in option 2.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'My' (प्रथम पुरुष) 'her' में बदलता है। 'Your' (द्वितीय पुरुष) 'his' में बदलता है। इसे विकल्प 2 में सही ढंग से लागू किया गया है।

practiceQuestions.sol_hi: संबोधन वाले आज्ञासूचक वाक्यों में, संज्ञा रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब का कर्म बन जाती है, जिसके बाद 'to open' और 'their books' का प्रयोग होता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Identify the error in indirect transformation: Direct: He said, "I am writing a letter now." -> Incorrect Indirect: He said that he was writing a letter now.

opts: The tense was not shifted from present continuous to past continuous.
The pronoun 'I' was wrongly changed.
The time adverb 'now' was not changed to 'then'.
The conjunction 'that' should not have been used.
opts_hi: काल को प्रेजेंट कंटीन्यूअस से पास्ट कंटीन्यूअस में नहीं बदला गया।
